baseline_models.mechanism: The focus-only reading is a two-part ignition machine: latent fire is present but unseen, and impact makes it appear.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: 100:2 word 1 as successful kindling or aid, plus word 2 as purposeful striking or planning.
baseline_models.mechanism: The focus roots allow ignition to mean effective activation: an intended action catches, succeeds, and begins to work.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: 100:2 word 1 can carry covering or hiddenness, while word 2 can carry scoring, boring, or flawing.

changed_reading.after: Ignition also becomes incision: the focus line can mark the first damaging opening of what was covered.

context_deltas.mechanism: The preceding motion and breath make the focus ignition bodily and kinetic: the spark is generated within a rushing sequence, not in a static tool scene.

changed_reading.after: 100:2 becomes the flash produced by a racing, breathing body at the point of collision.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next line makes the focus spark a threshold event: impact changes the state of the scene as night-hidden force moves into morning exposure.

changed_reading.before: The spark is a local physical flash.

changed_reading.after: The spark becomes the first visible wound in matter, followed by trace and dust.

context_deltas.mechanism: Entering the middle of a gathered mass turns the focus impact into a tactical point: the spark is the leading edge that opens a collective body.

changed_reading.after: The focus spark displays force turned against relation: helped energy becomes cutting ingratitude.

structural_cues: 100:9 opens an interrogative final scene with a timed uncovering after the desire diagnosis.

strongest_changes: The largest shift is from spark-as-event to spark-as-disclosure: hidden fire, covered graves, and chest contents all move from concealment to exposure.
The movement sequence makes 100:2 the kinetic hinge between rushing breath and entry into a gathered center.
The moral sequence interiorizes the same mechanics: desire and ingratitude become hidden fires that strike outward and then testify against the person.
summary.what_was_special: The focus ayah has two roots whose inventories lock strongly into ignition while also opening non-fire branches of concealment, scoring, decay, success, lots, and inward damage; the context repeatedly tests those alternatives instead of leaving the line as simple martial spectacle.
remaining_uncertainties: How much weight to give non-dominant split mappings for the first and fourth context cues.
Whether the concealment/scoring model should count as baseline or only as activated by the final disclosure verses.
Whether the lot, caries, and tiny-spark outliers should remain exploratory shadows or become explicit prose motifs.
